steps.name: Virtual Private Server
procedure_descriptions: During the [J-magic Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0050), threat actors acquired VPS for use in C2.(Citation: Lumen J-Magic JAN 2025)

steps.name: Digital Certificates
procedure_descriptions: During the [J-magic Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0050), threat actors used self-signed certificates on VPS C2 infrastructure.(Citation: Lumen J-Magic JAN 2025)

steps.name: Malware
procedure_descriptions: During the [J-magic Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0050) campaign, threat actors used open-source malware post-compromise including a custom variant of the cd00r backdoor.(Citation: Lumen J-Magic JAN 2025)

steps.name: Match Legitimate Resource Name or Location
procedure_descriptions: During the [J-magic Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0050), threat actors used the name “JunoscriptService” to masquerade malware as the Junos automation scripting service.(Citation: Lumen J-Magic JAN 2025)
